messages:
alana_cs: Heads-up — Kappa (acct KAP-42) renewal hit an e-sign exception. Procurement says they won't sign until the PO is embedded in the DocuSign envelope. We're on a pricing hold that'll expire tomorrow EOD. Need quick alignment on entity + PO attachment.

jason_ae: On it — do they have a PO number already? Who's the signer?

sophia_legal: Quick note: we can do an amendment to swap billing entity, but Legal needs the PO attached to the envelope or an explicit clause referencing the PO in the amendment. Also need signatory authority for the EU entity.

alana_cs: They provided PO #PO-8942. Signer is Oliver Kappa (CTO). Procurement insists the PO PDF must be in the envelope. Current quote is on Redwood US LLC. They want invoice to Kappa EU Ltd.

ben_revops: PO looks real from procurement email. VAT on PO: GB12345678. If we change invoice entity we'll need new invoice refs and tax info. That said, we can preserve the quoted pricing as long as amendment executes within 72h of quote. We're ~36h in, so still ok.

kai_onboarding: Heads-up — if we swap billing entity post-signature, onboarding mappings (billing_entity, invoice email, tax id, SSO mappings) will need updating. ETA ~24h after finance processes the change.

docusign-bot: Envelope 0a1b2c created by alana_cs — status: sent to signer (Oliver Kappa).

alana_cs: Procurement says the signer declined because attachment was missing. Can CS upload the PO into the envelope or do we need RevOps/Legal to reissue?

ben_revops: In exceptional cases CS can upload PO into envelope, but we need RevOps sign-off and legal confirmation that embedding is acceptable as proof of PO. @sophia_legal please confirm.

sophia_legal: Embedding PO inside the envelope is acceptable, provided the amendment text expressly states "PO attached and acknowledged" and we verify signatory authority. I'll draft the amendment clause now. Also need role/title confirmation for Oliver for EU entity signin.

jason_ae: Customer mentioned possible term tweak (12mo -> 9mo) during the procurement back-and-forth. Can we keep current Q3 discounted pricing if term is shortened?

ben_revops: Pricing protection keeps the quoted rate if amendment is executed within 72h and there's no material change to seat count or billing frequency. Shortening term is material — need finance approval. But if they accept same unit pricing and just shorten term, we might honor it as a one-off. I'll scope with finance now.

alana_cs: I'm asking procurement to send the PO PDF and a short confirmation of signatory authority (email + job title). Once I have the PDF I can upload to the envelope and re-send.

kai_onboarding: I'll prepare a short checklist for post-signature steps: 1) Update billing_entity, 2) Update invoice template (EU VAT), 3) Reissue invoice INV reference, 4) Confirm SSO mapping and seat assignments. ETA 4 hours after signature.

sophia_legal: Draft amendment text: "The Parties agree to swap the billing entity to Kappa EU Ltd. The PO attached to this envelope (PO-8942.pdf) is incorporated by reference and acknowledged. All other commercial terms, including pricing, remain unchanged. This amendment shall be effective upon signature by authorized representatives." Paste comments if you want edits.

docusign-bot: Envelope 0a1b2c — PO PDF 'PO-8942.pdf' uploaded by alana_cs — status: resent to signer.

jason_ae: Great. Once signed, confirm with Finance for invoice ref and we'll trigger onboarding entity change. @ben_revops please confirm new invoice reference format.

ben_revops: Confirmed — new invoice will be INV-2026-0894 (Kappa EU Ltd). Finance notified and ready to post after completed envelope.

alana_cs: Thanks. Updating Kappa CS notes: Renewal at risk due to e-sign exception; procurement sent PO PDF; amendment drafted; awaiting signer re-sign. I'll mark customer health as 'watch' until completed.

docusign-bot: Envelope 0a1b2c: Signed by Oliver Kappa — completed 3470001168.

alana_cs: :tada: Closed — PO attached, amendment signed, pricing preserved. Onboarding checklist linked to playbook and Gainsight. Filing notes and closing renewal task.
